mentions.name: AssetJay
mentions.description: AssetJay is an asset management tool that helps companies without IT departments keep track of the devices and peripherals they own.
mentions.problem: Companies without IT departments struggle to keep track of all the devices and peripherals they own as they grow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently building AssetJay, an asset management tools for companies without IT departments. When I grew my startup to 25 people, I always tried and failed to keep track of all the devices and peripherals we owned, so built https://assetjay.com to make it easy to do.
